name: Jeska
source:
Jeska is an elf who has dedicated her life to studying the art of witchcraft. She has crossed a great deal of lines in her pursuit of knowledge. That's fine with her. Jeska likes to give the impression that she is smarter than most by using unnecessarily large words. It doesn't usually work. Despite her inability to come across as a threat through words, her actual abilities are no joke. She seems to be a witch who's got it all.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=43343]Lemma Soft Forum thread[/url]]
